texts.zh:
长程传感器检测到一个大体积的无法鉴别身份的中空残骸突然出现的[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系。尽管我们对其设计很陌生，这个物体的组成成分中含有稀有的矿物，显示其建造过程中使用了先进的科技。物体的内侧表面包含了几百个接口和附着点，显然是为缺失的部分预留的。

就如同这个物体是随机地出现在[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系一样，它的内部部分就好像单纯地消失了一样。
texts.en:
Long-range sensors have detected the sudden appearance of an unidentified chunk of hollow debris in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. While alien in design, the object's rare-mineral composition suggests the use of advanced technology in its construction. The inner surface contains hundreds of ports and appendages that appear intended for lacking parts.

Just as the object appeared in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system at random, it is as if the missing interior simply vanished.

texts.zh:
我们对在[floating_shell_system.GetName]被我们发现的船壳进行了进一步的分析，确认了它是外星人舰船设计的一个样本。尽管没有动力，这个船壳本身有一些独特的特征，最有可能是一种先进形式的装甲覆盖。

然而，我们依然对于这个船壳来源于哪里、如何以及为什么出现在我们的宇域、它的内部（如果有的话）发生了什么毫无头绪。
texts.en:
Further analysis of the shell discovered in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system has confirmed it as an example of alien ship design. While lacking power, the hull itself possesses several unique characteristics, most notably an advanced form of armored cladding.

However, we are no closer to understanding where the hull originated from, how or why it appeared in our space, and what (if anything) happened to its interior.

texts.zh: 传感器检测到了又一个大体积的外星残骸，这一次是出现在[floating_engine_system.GetName]星系。这个物体在设计上同先前发现的外星人船壳很相似，其配置和错综复杂的结构表明它是某种引擎核心。安置在内部的是一个独特的装置，我们将其暂时称为一个“灵能调制器”。这个古怪的装置能让这艘舰船同虚境的灵能能量进行互动。尽管同我们的科技无法兼容，我们对其开展进一步的研究或许可以得到喜出望外的结果。
texts.en: Sensors have detected the appearance of another chunk of alien debris, this time in the [floating_engine_system.GetName] system. Similar in design to the recently discovered alien hull, the configuration and intricacy of the object suggests some type of engine core. Nestled inside was a unique apparatus that we have dubbed a 'psionic modulator.' This strange device would have allowed the ship to interact with psionic energy of the Shroud. While incompatible with our technology, further study may yield fascinating results.

label.zh: 解开谜题的拼图又多了一片。

texts.zh: 另一个在我们的宇域内随机出现的外星舰船部件被我们发现了，这一次是在[floating_core_system.GetName]星系。其中包括有条纹的甲板、没有墙的船员舱室以及一个先进电脑核心，毫无疑问这肯定是舰船船壳上面消失的内部部分。一旦全部三个部件都被集中到了一起，我们的工程师应该可以将这艘舰船组装成完整的状态。
texts.en: Another component from the alien vessel that has been appearing at random throughout our space has been detected in the [floating_core_system.GetName] system. Consisting of striated decks, unwalled crew-quarters, and an advanced computer core, there is no doubt that this must have comprised the bulk of the vessel's missing interior. Once all three components are brought together, our engineers should be able to assemble the ship in its entirety.

texts.zh: 我们已经成功地重新组装了这艘外星舰船。随着计算机核心上线，我们有可能下载和翻译舰船的日志。看上去这艘舰船还属于实验型号，设计目的是通过虚境的手段实现超光速旅行。尽管最后的船员日志和外部遥感勘测数据依然被扭曲，但是有一点很确定，那就是这艘舰船在处女航时出了什么大的差错。这艘舰船并不是因为爆炸解体，而是其部件被随机地扔回了正常空间。船员的命运尚且未知。
texts.en: We have succeeded in reassembling the alien vessel. With the computer core online, it was possible to download and translate the ship's logs. It seems the vessel was an experimental prototype, designed to achieve faster-than-light travel by means of the Shroud. Although the final crew logs and external telemetry remain garbled, there is no doubt that something went badly wrong on the vessel's maiden voyage. The ship was not so much blown apart as disassembled, its component pieces spat out at random into normal space. The fate of the crew remains unknown.

label.zh: 将这艘舰船编入我们的舰队。
label.en: Add the vessel to our fleet.

texts.zh: 这个看上去像是异星人舰船的外壳被发现漂浮在[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系。它是怎么到达那里的，这艘舰船的其他部分在哪里？
texts.en: The shell of what looks like an alien vessel was found floating in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. How did it get there, and where is the rest of the ship?

texts.zh: 外星舰船的最后一部分出现在了[floating_core_system.GetName]星系。我们的工程师需要时间重新组装这艘舰船。
texts.en: The final piece of the alien ship has appeared in the [floating_core_system.GetName]. Our engineers need time to reassemble the vessel.
